bankToMatch.title: Bank to match
bankToMatch.nothing: Everything the bank reported is matched.

title: Payments
hint: Money received and paid out, whether cash, mobile money, bank or card.
recordHint: For money received or paid that is not already part of a sale or a customer receipt.
emptyHint: Payments from sales and customer receipts appear here, and you can record others yourself.
noAccountForMethod: No account of this kind yet. The payment is recorded without one; add accounts under Payment accounts.
referenceHint: Transaction code, bank reference or cheque number.
phoneHint: Write it the way you would dial it locally; the business's calling code is added for you. Start with + to give a full number.
onThisPage: on this page, reversed ones left out
reverseAsk: Reverse payment {{number}}? The books are corrected with an opposite entry; the original stays on record.
reversedNote: This payment was reversed and no longer counts.
noMatchesHint: Cash needs no match. Mobile money and card payments are matched to what the provider reports.
settlement: Mobile money paid to the bank
settlementHint: Record the provider paying its takings (less charges) into the bank.
cashDepositHint: Record a branch taking its cash to the bank.
feeHint: What the provider kept. Leave empty for none.
requestsHint: Mobile money prompts sent to customers' phones, and whether they paid.
requestHint: A prompt appears on the customer's phone and they approve it with their PIN. Sending it twice by mistake only sends one.
noCollectionAccount: There is no mobile money account to collect into. Add one under Payment accounts first.
accountReferenceHint: Up to 12 characters, such as an invoice number. Optional.
noRequestsHint: Ask a customer to pay from their phone and follow the result here.

intentHints.pending: Ask them to check their phone and enter their PIN.
intentHints.succeeded: The money was received and recorded.
intentHints.failed: Nothing was charged. You can send a new request.
intentHints.cancelled: Nothing was charged. You can send a new request.
intentHints.timeout: The request expired. You can send a new one.

reconHint: Match what the provider or bank reported to the payments you recorded.
uploadHint: Upload the CSV your provider or bank gives you. Uploading the same file again adds nothing.
fileUnreadable: That file could not be read.
nothingUnmatchedHint: Transactions the provider reports that do not match a payment will appear here.
noTransactionsHint: Upload a statement or wait for the provider to report payments.
ignoreHint: Use this for transactions that are not part of the business's takings. Say why, for the record.
unignoreHint: Put this transaction back to be matched.
matchExplain: Choose the payment that this transaction paid.
noPaymentsToMatch: No mobile money payments to match with.
noPaymentsToMatchHint: Record the payment first, then come back.
noMatchesYetHint: Matches appear when payments are matched automatically or by hand.
undoMatchHint: The transaction and the payment become unmatched again. Say why, for the record.
closesHint: Count the day's takings per branch, explain any difference, then lock the day.
closeHint: See the day's takings and anything that stops it closing, enter the cash you banked, then lock it.
cashBankedHint: The cash you actually took to the bank or put in the safe.
explanationHint: There is a difference. Say what caused it before the day can be closed.
closeAsk: Lock {{date}}? Nothing can be recorded on that day afterwards unless it is reopened.
noClosesHint: Close each day to keep the cash and mobile money figures honest.
reopenHint: Ask to reopen {{date}}. Someone may need to approve it.
accountsHint: Where money comes in and goes out: cash, mobile money, bank and card.
noAccountsHint: Add the accounts you use, such as a cash drawer, a mobile money till and your bank.
name: Name
providerManual: No provider (record payments by hand or from statements)
providerNotOn: The provider {{name}} is not switched on for this business. Switch on its plugin in Add-ons, then come back.
providerHint: The service that sends payment prompts and reports payments for this account. Providers are plugins: switch one on in Add-ons.
accountNumberHint: Show only the last digits, like ****4821. Never type the full number.
branchHint: Leave on All branches if every branch uses it.
accountActiveHint: Switch off to stop using this account for new payments.
credentialsHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Saving new ones replaces the old.
callbackHint: Register these addresses with your provider so it can tell us about payments.
rotateAsk: This makes new addresses and the old ones stop working straight away. You must register the new ones with your provider.
callbackShownOnce: Copy these now. They are not shown again.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
